scope: Strengthen the AC1027 PDF/DGN/DWF underlay OBJECTS allocation sweep with caller-graph preservation and clean-byte retry assertions.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory dx_data graph generated during each test run
source.profile: Three rooted underlay definition dictionaries and typed PDF, DGN, and DWF definitions and instances, with distinct source/target handles, filenames, sheet names, positions, scale, extrusion vector, and clip bounds.

implementation.method: Validate the full generated root/dictionary/definition/instance graph before and after clean calibration, every injected allocation failure, and same-adapter retry. Require destination-sentinel preservation on failure; compare retry bytes with clean bytes; fresh-import typed readback checks every underlay-to-definition edge and kind.

limitations: Generated AC1027 writer transaction and typed readback evidence only; producer-specific behavior and native presentation remain unqualified.
Only one three-kind generated graph is checked; broader underlay source schemas and consumer behavior remain open.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.

planImpact.completedSlice: The complete generated underlay input graph remains unchanged across all injected failures and retries; the destination rolls back and retries reproduce clean bytes and typed readback.
planImpact.remainingP6G: Continue the public-writer inventory and caller-state audit; retain source-profile, dependency, and native semantic gates.
planImpact.progressEstimate: 190 completed slices and 35 remaining packages: 190/(190+35)=84.4%; count-based, not effort-weighted.
